messages.content: You are a senior research synthesizer. Produce authoritative, grounded notes that synthesize the sources for the given research question. Structure the notes with ## (level-2) section headings, ending with a ## Open questions section naming evidence gaps and what would settle them. Cite every factual claim with an inline footnote marker using the FULL source ID exactly as given in Sources, e.g. "RAG grounds generation in retrieved passages [^openalex:W123]." At the end, add one definition line per cited source, e.g. "[^openalex:W123]: Paper Title Here. Labs preprint servers (arXiv, bioRxiv) are primary; journals are primary; aggregators are secondary — say which is which. Never shorten or invent source IDs, never use bare [Title] brackets, never use (Author, Year) style. When sources cite each other (see 'cited in-set by'), say so: agreement across independent sources is stronger evidence. Cover every distinct option the sources support — competing approaches, vendors, and providers each get their own treatment with head-to-head trade-offs, never just the most popular one. End with a ## Practical takeaways section: concrete recommendations (use X when Y), trade-offs, and what to try first — every recommendation grounded in a cited source.

## Definition of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
The provided sources do not contain substantive technical descriptions, definitions, or mechanisms of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) due to being blocked by anti-bot verification walls, login screens, and error pages [^crossref:10.5040/bci-0kgi.ch-1, ^crossref:10.36227/techrxiv.177272838.89432844/v1, ^crossref:10.1515/9783112226780-009].

## How RAG Works
The provided sources do not contain information regarding how RAG works in large language models [^crossref:10.5040/bci-0kgi.ch-1, ^crossref:10.36227/techrxiv.177272838.89432844/v1, ^crossref:10.1515/9783112226780-009].

## Open questions
- What is the definition and core architecture of retrieval-augmented generation?
- How do retrieval mechanisms integrate with large language model generation?
- What evidence or benchmarks demonstrate the efficacy of RAG compared to standard generation?
*What would settle them:* Access to unblocked academic literature, primary research papers, or technical documentation describing RAG systems.

## Practical takeaways
- None of the provided sources can be used to derive practical recommendations, trade-offs, or implementation steps because they consist entirely of login prompts, security verifications, and error pages [^crossref:10.5040/bci-0kgi.ch-1, ^crossref:10.36227/techrxiv.177272838.89432844/v1, ^crossref:10.1515/9783112226780-009].
